context: A doctor explains lifestyle medicine to a teen
purpose: Teach: 反する/成り立っ/起こら/停滞/弊害/苦しむ/逃れ/迫ら

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 桜さん、健康的な生活、停滞しがちなときこそ大事ですよ。
lines.en: Sakura, healthy habits matter most when things feel like they're standing still.
lines.style: Steady, clear gaze. Warm without being performative. Matter-of-fact opening, then a small turn inward—this matters. Measured pace. Not lecturing, just honest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近、勉強の負荷から逃れたくて、つい夜更かしして苦しむんです。
lines.en: Lately I just want to escape the study pressure, so I end up staying up late and making myself worse.
lines.style: Quiet admission. Hesitant—checking if she's allowed to say this. Shame just beneath the surface. Trails off on 'worse' like she's still deciding whether to own it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 体に反する習慣、続けると小さな弊害が積み重なります。
lines.en: When you keep going against what your body needs, those small harms add up.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Patient tone—she's heard this before, so this is reinforcement, not revelation. Even pacing. Slight warmth on 'add up,' like she's seen this pattern many times.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験の前は、決断を迫られる感じで動けなくなって…。
lines.en: Before exams, I just freeze. I feel like I have to decide but I can't move.
lines.style: Soft, almost tentative. Opens quietly. Stalls slightly on 'freeze'—the word catches. Vulnerable without theatricality. Fades slightly at the end, uncertain whether this will make sense.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 計画は、無理が起こらないように立てましょう。一日が成り立っていく感覚、戻せるはず。
lines.en: Make a plan that doesn't demand too much of you. That sense of your day holding together—you can get that back.
lines.style: Warm but grounded. Slight emphasis on 'your day' and 'back'—this is both specific and hopeful. Slow, careful delivery, like she's placing words deliberately. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Quiet, genuine resolve. Not cheerful, but present. Small exhale before speaking, like she's actually committing. Brief and clear.
